St. Pauli vs RB Leipzig: Live Stream & Watch Online

The Bundesliga clash between St. Pauli and RB Leipzig on January 27, 2026, promises to be an exciting encounter as both teams are desperate for points in this crucial matchup. St. Pauli, known for their passionate home support at the Millerntor-Stadion, looks to capitalize on playing at home. Meanwhile, RB Leipzig aims to maintain their position in the upper echelon of the Bundesliga standings as they pursue a Champions League spot. With both teams in varying forms, this match could have significant implications for the remainder of the season.

Kick-off: 27.01.2026, 19:30 UTC / 22:30 MSK
Stadium: Millerntor-Stadion
Competition: Bundesliga

Match Preview

St. Pauli enters the match following a series of mixed results, with standout performances but inconsistent outcomes. The team is looking to harness their home advantage, having recently showcased a resilient defense. Coach Timo Schultz has been working on fine-tuning the squad's tactical discipline, aiming to frustrate their opponents and strike on the counter. Additionally, the home crowd's support could be pivotal in boosting morale and performance on the pitch.

On the other hand, RB Leipzig, under the astute management of Marco Rose, has been in impressive form, seeking to capitalize on their attacking prowess. Leipzig has been consistently finding the net and showcasing an organized defense that has kept several clean sheets this season. However, they will need to ensure they don’t underestimate a spirited St. Pauli side, especially in front of their fans. With key players hitting form at the right time, the visitors come into this match confident and focused.

Team Form and Analysis

St. Pauli

St. Pauli's defense has been resilient, often closing down opponents' attacking plays effectively, but they have struggled with consistency in attack. With a few injuries affecting key attackers, the team is looking to their midfielders to step up and create chances. The return of one or two players from injury could provide a much-needed boost. Look out for captain Bastian Schonlau to lead both defense and morale as they aim to unsettle Leipzig's front line.

RB Leipzig

RB Leipzig has been dynamic in both defending and attacking plays, showcasing a fluid style of football. Their pace on the wings and creative midfielders have been instrumental in recent matches. They are currently missing a couple of key players due to injury but have adequate depth to fill those gaps. Expect Leipzig to adopt an aggressive approach with RB's attacking duo likely to explore the flanks and press high when St. Pauli looks to build from the back.

Predicted Starting Lineups

  • St. Pauli:
    • Goalkeeper: Robin Himmelmann
    • Defenders: Eric Smith, Bastian Schonlau, Philipp Ziereis, Luca Zander
    • Midfielders: Leart Paqarada, Johannes Evstwig, Finn Ole Becker
    • Forwards: Guido Burgstaller, Daniel-Kofi Kyeremateng, David Otto
  • RB Leipzig:
    • Goalkeeper: Peter Gulacsi
    • Defenders: Willi Orban, Josko Gvardiol, Lukas Klostermann
    • Midfielders: Kevin Kampl, Konrad Laimer, Dani Olmo
    • Forwards: Christopher Nkunku, Andrej Kramaric, Timo Werner

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

  • Main Prediction: RB Leipzig to Win

    • With their recent form and attacking quality, Leipzig looks likely to emerge victorious against St. Pauli.

  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals

    • Both teams have shown propensity to score, and with St. Pauli's ability to break quickly, a high-scoring affair seems probable.

Catch all the action live on January 27, 2026, as St. Pauli hosts RB Leipzig in an engaging Bundesliga encounter. Don't miss the chance to see these two teams battle it out on the pitch!

Werder Bremen vs Hoffenheim: Live Stream & Watch Online

The upcoming clash between Werder Bremen and Hoffenheim in the Bundesliga carries significant implications as both teams strive for a better position in the league. As the season reaches its midway point, each point becomes increasingly vital. Werder Bremen will be looking to leverage home advantage to climb the table, while Hoffenheim aims for a crucial away victory to enhance their playoff aspirations. With both sides having showcased inconsistent form leading up to this match, fans can expect an exciting contest filled with intensity and critical moments. Kick-off: January 27, 2026, 19:30 UTC / 22:30 MSK
Stadium: Wohninvest Weserstadion, Bremen
Competition: Bundesliga

Match Preview

Entering this clash, Werder Bremen has seen a mixture of highs and lows in their recent performances. Managed by Ole Werner, the team has found themselves struggling to find consistent form but will be buoyed by the home support at Weserstadion. On the other hand, Hoffenheim, under the guidance of Pellegrino Matarazzo, has shown flashes of brilliance but often falters against tougher competition. The pressure is mounting for both coaches as the points from this match are crucial in avoiding relegation threats and securing a respectable league position. In terms of lineups, there are concerns on both sides regarding injuries that could impact their performance. Bremen's attacking strength will be assessed with the potential return of key players, while Hoffenheim will rely on their tactical flexibility and depth to adapt to whatever tactics Bremen deploys.

Team Form and Analysis

Werder Bremen

Werder Bremen's defensive frailties have been exposed in the last few fixtures, leading to a need for significant improvement if they wish to contend for a higher league position. The team has struggled to maintain leads and has conceded critical goals late in matches. Going forward, Bremen's attack will rely heavily on the form of their star striker, who has been effective at home. However, with some injuries affecting key players, Coach Werner must decide on adjustments to both the lineup and formation, which may include returning options that can bolster their performance.

Hoffenheim

Hoffenheim has enjoyed a relatively balanced attack, but inconsistency has plagued their results. Their ability to exploit opponents' weaknesses will be critical in this matchup against a Bremen side looking for redemption. Coach Matarazzo has emphasized a collective effort, focusing on pressing high and utilizing quick transitions. Key injuries in their midfield could impact their possession game; however, the team possesses several capable players who can step up in these situations, making the game even more unpredictable.

    • Midfielders: Stage, Gruev

  • Hoffenheim: 3-4-3
    • Goalkeeper: Baumann
    • Defenders: Vogt, Posch, Kabak
    • Midfielders: Kramaric, Grillitsch, Baumgartner, Rudy
    • Forwards: Bebou, Dabbur, Kramaric

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

  • Main Prediction: Werder Bremen to Win - With home advantage and returning players, Bremen should capitalize on their attacking prowess.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals - Both teams have shown confidence in front of goal, suggesting an entertaining match with multiple goals.

Fiorentina vs Como: Live Stream & Watch Online

The Coppa Italia is set to feature an exciting clash as Fiorentina hosts Como on January 27, 2026. This match represents a pivotal moment in the knockout stages of Italy's prestigious cup competition. Fiorentina, known for their passionate play and tactical prowess, will look to assert their dominance at home, while Como aims to cause an upset against higher-ranked opposition. Both teams bring distinctive styles to the pitch, making this fixture one to watch closely.

Kick-off: 27.01.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Stadio Artemio Franchi
Competition: Coppa Italia

Match Preview

Fiorentina enters this match with a mixed bag of results in recent Serie A outings, hovering in the mid-table. Their emphasis on a strong attacking play has yielded some entertaining matches, but inconsistency has prevented them from securing a spot in the coveted European competitions. Manager Vincenzo Italiano will be keen to prioritize this cup run and possibly unlock a route to continental football through it.

Conversely, Como has been battling hard in Serie B, currently fighting for a playoff spot. Their determined spirit, coupled with some impressive recent form, could pose a challenge for Fiorentina. Under manager Giacomo Gattuso, Como has displayed resilience and tactical discipline that may be pivotal as they aim to upset the higher-ranked Fiorentina. With both teams eager to progress, this encounter promises to deliver excitement and potential drama.

Team Form and Analysis

Fiorentina

Fiorentina has displayed a solid attacking front this season, with players like Nicolas Gonzalez and Luka Jovic leading the charge in goal contributions. While their defense has been competent, lapses in concentration have led to some frustrating results against lower-ranked teams. The team looks forward to the return of key defender Nikola Milenkovic, who missed the last few matches due to injury. With a strong home crowd expected, the pressure will be on Fiorentina to deliver a compelling performance.

Como

Como's defensive solidity has been one of their strengths in the lower division. They often set up in a compact shape, looking to absorb pressure and strike on the counter with the pace of their forwards. Key player Samuele Giannotte has been in fine form, linking well with the midfield. Injuries have been minimal, allowing Gattuso to maintain consistency in his starting lineup. Expect Como to adopt a cautious approach, looking for opportunities to exploit any defensive vulnerabilities from Fiorentina.

Predicted Starting Lineups

  • Fiorentina (4-3-3):
    • Goalkeeper: Pietro Terracciano
    • Defenders: Lorenzo Venuti, Nikola Milenkovic, Luca Ranieri, Cristiano Biraghi
    • Midfielders: Sofyan Amrabat, Giacomo Bonaventura, Alfred Duncan
    • Forwards: Nicolas Gonzalez, Luka Jovic, Riccardo Sottil
  • Como (5-3-2):
    • Goalkeeper: Marco Sportiello
    • Defenders: Marco Varnier, Gianluca Lagos, Ricardo Pereira, Andrea Conti, Giuseppe Bellusci
    • Midfielders: Filippo Galli, Bismark Adjei-Boateng, Patrick Cutrone
    • Forwards: Samuele Giannotte, Alberto Cerri

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

  • Main Prediction: Fiorentina to Win

    • Fiorentina's attacking talents at home should give them the edge over Como, who has not faced top-tier opposition recently.

  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals

    • Expect a tightly contested match; Como's defensive organization may stifle Fiorentina's scoring opportunities.

For those looking to catch every moment of the action, you can watch the live stream of the match on various platforms. Stay tuned for an unforgettable Coppa Italia showdown!
